thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary cluster 'wave-7' reporting elevated 5xx rate (avg 6.8% over 3 min). Healthcheck failures rising. Triggering alert policy: canary-elevated-5xx
Derek Nguyen: I'm on it. grabbing logs and load metrics. Any ETA on the rollout that touched wave-7?
Maria Chen: wave-7 started at 1745003000 — it's a gradual rollout for model v3-quant. Last config change was batching=auto and kv_cache enabled.
Sasha Rinaldi: seeing similar on the dashboard — error spike aligns with short-lived spikes in latency per-token as well. Could be kv cache eviction thrash on long tails.
Kevin Liu: paging infra: checking pods on region-us-east-2. `kubectl get pods -l rollout=wave-7 -o wide` shows 4 pods in CrashLoopBackOff and 2 with restarts.
Derek Nguyen: copy. scaling down traffic to wave-7 to 5% as a partial mitigation. doing `redwood rollout traffic set wave-7 0.05` now.
oncall-rotation: +1 on reducing blast radius. Any customer-facing errors reported?
Maria Chen: Sentry shows increased 5xx for a handful of premium customers hitting long-context generation. Most errors are 503/524 from the serving runtime, not auth.
Sasha Rinaldi: stack traces point to KV cache KeyError followed by a retry storm. suspect newer kernel path in v3-quant.
incident-bot: Canary abort criteria check: 1) 5xx > 5% sustained >2min -> triggered. 2) Erroring pods > 10% -> triggered.
Derek Nguyen: given both abort conditions hit, recommend kill the canary and roll back. Options: A) flip feature flag to route wave-7 traffic to v2 fallback, B) rollback to previous model version on wave-7, C) scale additional capacity while investigating. My vote: A then B if quick rollback necessary.
Kevin Liu: I can flip the routing flag. command: `redwood feature toggle route_wave_7_to_fallback --on` — doing it; will post when done.
Maria Chen: pushing a quick monitoring delta: adding a synthetic prompt to verify end-to-end after traffic switch.
Kevin Liu: done. `route_wave_7_to_fallback` enabled. Traffic now at 0% served by v3-quant, routed to v2-stable.
Sasha Rinaldi: dashboards show 5xx dropping back towards baseline within 45s. latency also normalizing. Good signal.
Derek Nguyen: going to mark the canary as aborted in the rollout: `redwood rollout abort --id=wave-7 --reason="kv-cache regression v3-quant"`.
Derek Nguyen: abort issued. Notifying release lead and ownership. @Maria C can you collect core dumps and the last 50 logs from failing pods for the model team? include model metadata and kernel selections.
Maria Chen: collecting and uploading artifacts to the incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1745003210/. Links: https://s3.redwood/1745003210/logs.tar.gz and https://s3.redwood/1745003210/cores.tar.gz
incident-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-1745003210. Pager duty notified for on-call handoff in 15m.
Kevin Liu: Customer impact: approx ~0.08% of total requests experienced 503s (mostly long-context enterprise tenants). I'll draft a blameless customer note and share with support ops.
Sasha Rinaldi: initial hypothesis: kv-cache path in quantized kernel not handling multi-epoch cache eviction correctly under roll-forward batching. Will pull a reproducible test in staging.
Derek Nguyen: good. For now checklist: 1) canary aborted (done), 2) artifacts collected (done), 3) traffic normalized (observed), 4) rollback plan documented. Anyone want to take postmortem lead?
Maria Chen: I can lead the postmortem and coordinate with model infra + runtime teams. I'll schedule follow-up 1hr post-incident to capture timeline.
Kevin Liu: I'll coordinate customer comms and help reproduce on staging.
Sasha Rinaldi: I'll own reproducer and test vector for kv cache.
Derek Nguyen: thanks all. handing off to next oncall in 10m — please monitor for 30 minutes to ensure no regression. Leaving channel. :thumbsup:
oncall-rotation: taking over monitoring, will escalate if anything pops.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: Derek Nguyen -> oncall-rotation at 1745003560.
Derek Nguyen: final note: keep wave-7 disabled until PR #4621 with kv-cache guard lands and passes staging.
Maria Chen: ack. I'll include that in the postmortem and link the PR.
Sasha Rinaldi: ack. saving reproducer in repo: infra/kv-cache/regressors/wave7
Kevin Liu: drafting short customer message now. will post in #support once reviewed.
incident-bot: Thread closed for new alerts, monitoring will continue for 60m.
